Truck Engine
By andreviewport

CC BY 4.0
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Geometry optimized and Meshopt compressed for web display. Textures resized and compressed where present. Framing, lighting and camera motion adapted. Engine paint and material finish adapted to the Sampson palette; unused texture coordinates removed. Static engine poster cropped and resized from the original model preview.
